about: Twist cards: a rule both rappers follow for one bout. Objects can set "seconds" to change the verse length.
cards: Every bar has to mention food.
Rap the whole verse in a whisper.
Start every bar with the same word.
You can't say “I”, “me” or “my”.
Narrate it like a nature documentary.
Work in the name of someone in the room who isn't battling.
Every bar ends with a question.
Call it like a sports commentator.
It's a love song… to your opponent's shoes.
Slip a weather forecast into your verse.
Rhyme with your opponent's name at least once.
Sneak in three colors.
One bar has to be in an accent.
Every bar starts with “Yo”.
Rap like a movie villain monologuing.
Mention something you can see in the room right now.
Put an animal in every other bar.
Your opponent picks one word you must use. Ask them now.
Eyes closed for the whole verse.
Put a number in every bar.

cards.text: Speed round: 20 seconds each. No warm-up.
Marathon: 90 seconds each. Fill every one of them.

cards: The crowd shouts a topic. You rap about it.
No swearing. Get creative.
Pretend you're accepting an award.
You must compliment your opponent once — and make it hurt.
Rap it like a bedtime story.
Every bar mentions a celebrity.
Drop a fake fun fact.
End your verse with a mic drop pose. Hold it.
